title: Affiliate networks drop the ball: stay hands-on with data and stand out in job hunts
summary: Dustin recaps a Real Talk Friday chat with Christen Evans on affiliate network failures (an eight-month tracking outage billed on estimates, removed affiliates still earning via bookmarked links). He also shares how a three-minute video and dedicated page got him a job interview, and urges early Q4 prep.

principles.text: Network quirks and estimated commissions can cause major headaches, so monitor your affiliate data diligently and stay hands-on.
principles.quote: Stay Hands-On with Data: Network quirks like "bookmarked links" and estimated commissions can cause major headaches. Diligent monitoring is key.

principles.text: Networks should flag tracking problems early; long outages billed on generic estimates are hard to verify and unfair.
principles.quote: The network should have flagged the issue much earlier instead of blindsiding them with a massive invoice.

principles.text: Stand out in a competitive job market with a creative, personalized approach such as a short video and dedicated page.
principles.quote: I made a three-minute YouTube video and a dedicated page explaining why I’d be a great hire. It got me in the door and landed that crucial first interview.

principles.text: Prepare for Q4 early: lock in placements and finalize strategies before the holiday rush.
principles.quote: Prepare for Q4 Early: The holiday rush is coming fast. Now’s the time to lock in placements and finalize strategies.
